g.text: Single sign-on — one login, many applications
3) IdP issues a signed assertion / token
each app trusts the IdP's signature
SAML XML assertions, browser POST, entrenched in enterprise
OIDC JSON over OAuth 2.0, mobile-friendly, what new systems use
The IdP is now a single point of failure AND the highest-value
target you own. One compromise reaches every application.
